title: Yaya’s Stuffed Peppers
tagline: Green and hot peppers stuffed with meat, rice, and dill, baked in tomato sauce.

items: 1–2 cups of rice (depending on personal preference… we prefer 1 cup)
1 large can of water (empty the sauce into a large bowl, then fill the empty can with water and combine)

steps.text: Pre-heat the oven to 375 degrees. Clean out the peppers, reserving the tops. Stab a few holes at the base of the bell peppers to allow liquid to penetrate.
Place bell peppers upright in a large pan. All of the other peppers get scattered on their sides later, after stuffing.
Sauté the onion in a little olive oil until limp 😂 Add meat and brown with salt and pepper to taste. Add dill, rice, and simmer about 10 minutes.
Add chopped parsley and stuff all the peppers with the stuffing, adding tops back on. Scatter the other stuffed peppers on their sides around the bell peppers.
Mix the tomato sauce with the can of water and pour over all the peppers. Brush peppers with olive oil.
Cook for about 1.5 hours, checking for over-browning. Pepper tops should be nice and brown. If over-browning, cover with tin foil.
Insert a fork into the side of the bell pepper periodically. Fork should slide in “like butter” — very soft!
Remove from oven and let sit for 10 minutes covered.
Serve and enjoy! The jalapeños will impart a nice heat to the sauce of the dish.

signoff: Love, mom & dad …but really dad’s recipe😁
